topic: How does the hybrid SIW-waveguide feeding topology balance efficiency and compactness in V-band satellite antenna designs?
response: The hybrid SIW-waveguide feeding topology balances efficiency and compactness by optimizing the feeding structure to reduce insertion loss, achieving 41% efficiency and 39.2 dB gain at 59 GHz, with a 14.6% reflection coefficient bandwidth.
reference_context: Hybrid SIW-waveguide antenna design optimizes efficiency and compactness for V-band inter-satellite links, achieving high gain and wide bandwidth.
